Name: Dateable NPC Photos SVE
Author: BaneOfDagon
Description:
This mod adds photos of the 5 dateable NPCs of Starew Valley Expanded, an add on to the Dateable NPC Photos by LxttieDxll. This does NOT contain the 12 main bachelors and bachelorettes from the vanilla game, you will need to download the original mod. [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16884]The Original Mod - Dateable NPC Photos by LxttieDxll[/url]

This mod can work without Dateable NPC Photos bt LxttieDxll, but I highly reccomend using both so you are able to put all bachelors and bachelorettes on your wall. This mod includes Magnus (The Wizard), Victor, Sophia, Olivia, and Claire. I may add Krobus later on and change some of the background colors for the photos, I'm pretty pleased with what I have now, but they certainly don't pop like the original mod does. If you have any questions, concerns, or suggestions (especially for what color the background frames should be) my DMs are open!

This mod requires Alternative Textures to work, it replaces the painting "Calico Falls" like the original mod does.

PLEASE! Check out the original mod! [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16884]The Original Mod - Dateable NPC Photos by LxttieDxll[/url]
[url=http://https//www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16884]
[/url]This is my first mod, I apologise if it's buggy but writing in JSON is strange to me, I've never coded before.

UPDATE 2.0.0 IS OUT! - This mod NOW includes both Krobus AND Lance! I havent played SVE for long enough to get to GI and I didn't even realise Lance existed, that's on me fs. BUT! Now he's in here with Krobus too! YAY! ALSO the links have been fixed (I didn't realise that it automatically typed the https part so it ad two and would error if you tried to click on the other mod.) TY to the people that commented on my stupid mistakes, LY all! <3
